info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

post.summary: ingest persists a CycloneDX SBOM's components keyed by image digest.
post.description:
ingest persists a CycloneDX SBOM's components keyed by image digest.

Gated to a validated SuperAdmin (owner == AdminOrg) — the canonical cloud
super-admin check, which the build fleet / CI carries.
Re-ingest is idempotent: rows share the (digest, name, version, purl) ORDER BY,
so ReplacingMergeTree keeps the latest by ingested_at (and resolve reads FINAL).

get.summary: health reports liveness and whether the global SBOM store is reachable.
get.description:
health reports liveness and whether the global SBOM store is reachable.

It is a pure probe: not JWT-gated, and always 200.
A disconnected datastore is degraded-but-alive, reported as datastore:false
here and as a 503 by the routes that need it.

document.description:
Document is the raw CycloneDX document.
Its components[] are flattened and persisted; the document itself is not
stored, and a malformed one is refused rather than half-ingested.

format.description: Format names the document dialect. Only cyclonedx is parsed.

gitSha.description: GitSha is the commit the image was built from, recorded for provenance.

imageDigest.description:
ImageDigest is the content-addressed image key, sha256:… — REQUIRED, and
the key everything is filed and resolved under.

imageRef.description:
ImageRef is the human image reference the digest was published as, so a
console can resolve by tag as well as by digest.

sourceRepo.description: SourceRepo is the repo the image was built from, recorded for provenance.

datastore.description:
Datastore reports whether the datastore connection is up.
False means the data routes answer 503; the process is still alive.

service.description: Service is always "sbom" — which subsystem answered.

status.description: Status is always "ok": the route answers 200 whenever the process is alive.

table.description: Table is the global, cross-tenant table components are filed in.

componentCount.description:
ComponentCount is how many components the document flattened to.
A valid document with no components is 0, not an error.

imageDigest.description: ImageDigest is the content-addressed key the components were filed under.
